Application Data.NAME: Creative Solutions Advertising Agency
Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: Creative Solutions Advertising Agency specializes in providing comprehensive advertising and marketing services to a diverse range of clients across various industries. Our operations include creative development, media planning and buying, digital marketing, social media management, branding strategy, and market research. We emphasize a collaborative approach, ensuring that all campaigns adhere to client specifications and industry standards, with a strong focus on maintaining compliance with advertising regulations. Our dedicated team is committed to delivering high-quality content while upholding intellectual property rights and implementing robust cybersecurity measures to protect sensitive client information. We maintain documented client approval processes to minimize errors and ensure clarity in our deliverables, fostering long-term relationships built on trust and transparency.

Application Data.OTHER BUSINESSES OWNED: Creative Solutions Media Group, LLC; 4567 Elm Street, Suite 200, Springfield, IL 62701-1234; Primary focus on digital marketing and content creation services.
Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: On January 10, 2023, Creative Solutions Advertising Agency experienced a loss due to a minor data breach resulting in unauthorized access to client information. The breach was detected and contained within 24 hours, but approximately 50 client records were compromised. The estimated cost for notification and credit monitoring services amounted to $10,000. The claim has been submitted to the cyber liability insurance provider, and it is currently under review.
